title: Hosted API: Getting Started flow - model picker + request builder screenshots
creator: Asha Patel
description: Objective: Create a coherent set of high-fidelity screenshots and export assets for the Hosted API getting-started flow used in docs, the console quickstart, and marketing one-pagers. The scope includes: model selection modal (compact + expanded), request builder states (default prompt, streaming on/off, function-calling example), inline code panel with language tabs (curl, JavaScript, Python), and an annotated hero image for the docs landing page. Deliverables must be anonymized (no real API keys/org IDs), accessible (clear focus states), and exported to spec for web and retina displays. Context: This refresh is part of the larger "Hosted API Quickstart Refresh" PRD and aims to reduce first-API friction by clarifying model selection and showing a working request builder with copy-to-clipboard and streaming preview. Work should align with new console colors and updated typography tokens (see design system token v3).
acceptance_criteria: Model picker: three variations exported (compact list, modal with details, variant selector) with clear labels for model family, latency estimate, and recommended use-case
Request builder: four states exported (empty prompt, filled prompt + example, streaming enabled with streaming indicator, function-calling toggle enabled with sample JSON schema shown)
Code snippets: updated curl/JS/Python examples that match current API surface; all snippets copy-ready and tested against sandbox environment (placeholders for keys)
Accessibility: each screenshot includes high-contrast focus ring for keyboard navigation and visible aria-label hints in annotations
Export specs: images delivered as PNG@2x and WebP@2x, widths 1280px for hero shots, 800px for inline docs screenshots, with filenames matching docs import pattern
Design handoff: Figma file annotated with export slices and an assets sheet; a short Loom walkthrough recorded and linked
All images anonymized: no real tokens, org names, or user avatars present
